messages:
maya: Kickoff — we need a lean runbook for the QBR on Wed. Focus: onboarding status, renewal flags, and 3-slide exec ask. Who can own slides 2 & 3?
liam: I can take slide 2 (onboarding health + adoption metrics). Will pull usage chart from Looker.
sofia: I'll do slide 3 (enablement / feedback themes) — will summarize training uptake and top 5 CSAT comments.
eli: I’ll prep the exec ask slide and the 1-line renewal risk summary. Can we agree thresholds for 'at risk'?
maya: Yes — propose: <50% product usage week-over-week OR NPS drop >=6 pts => Risk. Thoughts?
sofia: sounds good. I'll add a short note about mitigations (enablement play, custom onboarding session).
liam: Looker query I’ll use: 
```sql
SELECT week, active_users, pct_change FROM cs_prod_usage WHERE account_id = 123
``` 
I'll paste chart by EOD.
maya: @eli can you confirm exec availability for the 20-min readout at 10am PT? Also want a single senior ask (discount? support hours?).
eli: 10am PT works. Senior ask will be 'allocate 8 support hours + dedicated SE for 3 months' — I'll phrase as ROI (reduction in time-to-value).
onboarding-bot: Reminder: QBR slide template v2 uploaded: https://drive.redwood/qbr-template-v2
sofia: Capturing action items: 1) liam charts by EOD, 2) sofia slide draft by tomorrow noon, 3) eli final exec ask + talk track, 4) maya consolidate and send runbook.
maya: Also flag renewal cadence: @eli — is there a hard renewal date in the next 90 days? If yes, include contract bucket.
eli: Renewal 88 days out. I'll add to slide footer and note upsell opportunities.
liam: Quick call to align on the demo flow tomorrow 11am? 15 mins.
sofia: yes, include a short demo of the onboarding wizard — 3 bullets max.
maya: Great. I'll assemble slides and post draft for review in this thread. :thumbsup:
eli: Thanks all — will be ready to present.
